rebuttal_or_critique: I remain firm in my assessment that the current policy stance of withdrawal of accommodation is necessary. While I acknowledge the moderation in core inflation to 3.10%, the headline CPI at 4.75% remains above our 4.00% target. Most critically, the persistent food inflation at 8.69% poses a significant risk to the rural economy and household inflation expectations. Given the positive output gap of 0.40% and the inherent uncertainties regarding monsoon outcomes, any premature shift in stance could be misconstrued as a dilution of our commitment to price stability. I am not prepared to compromise on the stance at this juncture as we must ensure inflation durably aligns with the target.
